roots.importedOperatorSource: Portal package.json resolves @papercusp/operator-ui and @papercusp/operator-core from operatorSource; build aliases compose their maintained components.
roots.limit: Source/runtime manifest observations only. Imported operator bytes in the serving artifact and authenticated hosted acceptance are not verified by this census.

entrySeam.currentBehavior: PortalEntry routes workspace-null sessions to FirstRunPortal and selected-workspace sessions to Home. It has no persistent tutorial enrollment check.
entrySeam.admission: Successful authenticated self-signup commits organization, membership, legal acceptance, free entitlement and session atomically. Enroll the account+organization in that transaction, including identities adopted from a prior provider projection.
entrySeam.replay: Completed signup attempts return an existing session before account admission. Neither replay, duplicate_identity sign-in nor a signup URL may initialize/reset enrollment or completed progress.
entrySeam.invitationPolicy: Initialize enrollment at the canonical successful new-membership admission as well, including invitation/preassigned-workspace accounts. Existing/legacy memberships remain opt-in unless already enrolled; do not infer enrollment from workspace absence or timestamps.
entrySeam.storage: Extend hosted_user_preferences.profile with versioned account-orientation enrollment/CAS progress keyed by organization+user, before workspace selection. Retain cloudTutorial's existing workspace+lesson+version keys and CAS/idempotency behavior.
entrySeam.authority: Reuse the verified hosted principal and organization+user preference RLS. Account orientation reads must not require or fabricate a selected workspace. Workspace operations and existing workspace progress/help keep selectedHostedPrincipal and workspace:view checks.
entrySeam.portalBoundary: Minimal authenticated progress read/update and Guide mount before FirstRunPortal/Home. The portal's generic /api/preferences is user-only (serviceFor(userId)); it cannot substitute for organization+user hosted tutorial authority.

policies.navigation: Use only registered enabled routes. Explain permission-denied, unavailable, disabled or missing-target states without claiming the feature worked. Opening a route is not proof of a domain action.
policies.workspace: Explain workspace selection and required permissions. Preserve explicit user provisioning/launch/submission; never operate through a guide navigation or Help action.
policies.connected: Mail, Calendar and Phone need their configured authorized integration. Teach disconnected/unavailable recovery without connecting, sending or placing calls.
policies.help: Contextual Help owns the lesson explanation; Support/docs are fallback destinations. Do not send secrets or private workspace content to Help. Before workspace selection use account-scoped lesson context, never a fabricated workspace.
policies.progress: Persist only navigation/inspection receipts and disposition for orientation. Domain completion still requires current authorized product observations correlated to its scope and task.
policies.voice: Spoken questions require an explicit gesture and microphone consent. The protected Papercusp tutorial account must be server-side, authenticated, purpose-bound, limited and cancellable; unavailable voice keeps text Help usable. Generic chat voice preferences are not authorization to start tutorial capture.

Open an authorized prepared workspace desktop and review its readiness.

Review questions and approvals before choosing an answer.
Select an existing workspace or explicitly review a new connection/provisioning request.
Read workspace overview and current scope.
Read agent status, activity and evidence without inferring completion from presence.
Find pots and work items, assignments and blocked work.
Review retained lessons for the selected pot.
Inspect workflow structure before explicitly running it.
Explore proposals without mistaking suggestions for approved work.
Read health evidence and distinguish unknown from healthy.
Review pull requests; merging or publishing remains an explicit product action.
Read source-backed insights for the selected pot.
Find durable discussions and their work context.
Inspect pot settings; changes need appropriate permissions.
Read project documentation with the selected pot context.
Read historical events; history and current state answer different questions.

nonRail.teaches: Find registered apps, including destinations in More.
Find unpinned destinations; pinning is a preference, not permission.
Review identity, organization, session status and sign-out.
Inspect the authorized agent roster; launching remains explicit.
Inspect running task/process evidence and its freshness.
Read session history and reopen the intended conversation.
Choose a configured chat voice engine; tutorial recording has separate consent.
Use the quick palette for prompts, brainstorm and docs.
Review model/provider accounts; keep credentials out of lesson Help.
Give a goal, context and output; verify answers and request corrections.
Read current organization subscription and receipts; checkout, management and cancellation require billing permission and explicit action.
Search loaded content and inspect partial/unknown search coverage.
Choose theme/layout preferences and learn which settings persist across devices.
Ask an optional spoken lesson question only after microphone consent; retain text Help and stop/cancel controls.

helpOwner: Existing contextual tutorial Help plus Support/project docs; P-016 must bind each entry's module and availability to the maintained lesson content.

billingTeaching.subscription: Organization subscription is configured by the hosted billing runtime. Teach the current authenticated plan/status and Stripe-hosted checkout/manage/cancel flow; no remembered or invented prices/entitlements.
billingTeaching.providerUsage: Model/provider accounts and Google Cloud resources have separate usage charges. Selecting a model or account is not proof Papercusp pays that provider bill. Retained cloud resources can continue charging after a session ends.
billingTeaching.receipts: Billing receipts expose signed minor-unit amounts and currency; explain pending versus verifiable receipts and use the existing currency formatter.
billingTeaching.unknown: If billing is unconfigured, permission-denied or unavailable, say so and retain Help. Do not invent quotas, free allowances, subscription discounts or voice inclusion.

acceptanceStillRequired: P-015 account-first entry and versioned account/org progress
P-016 catalogue-complete implemented curriculum and real permitted targets
P-013 billing content sourced to current policy
P-012 protected consented tutorial voice and exact hosted acceptance/shipment
